personalInfo.bio:
Passionate Python developer with 7+ years of experience building backend systems, data pipelines, and scalable APIs. Currently leading technical teams, designing architectures, and mentoring developers. Skilled in modern Python frameworks (FastAPI, Django), asynchronous programming, and database design. Always seeking ways to improve codebases and team dynamics through patterns, documentation, and clear processes.
Looking for opportunities to continue growing in architecture, clean code, and high-impact backend systems.
personalInfo.title: Teach Lead & Technical Speaker

talks.title: Best Practices for Planning Features (For Devs & Tech Leads)
talks.description: In this video I share my process of planing a feature, how to find the main responsibilities,  how to write tickets, how to avoid bottlenecks and how to provide visibility to business and the team.

talks.title: Fight Against the Rabbit Hole
talks.description: Good practices, some hacks and a brief go through all the places where you can find rabbit holes as a software developer and how to avoid them.

talks.title: Service Pattern - A Good Place to Put Business Logic
talks.description: Learn about the service pattern, its advantages, how to implement it, and best practices for organizing business logic in your applications.

talks.title: Client Pattern
talks.description: Why to use the client pattern to connect to 3rd party services, how to test it and implement it

talks.title: ArmoniBot - Building Something for Myself, But in a Sustainable Way
talks.description: A journey of building ArmoniBot - how it was born, how I organized the work, and the problems I encountered along the way.
